now.status: Learning Python, one rep at a time.
now.intro: I set my old self-built EECS curriculum aside. The new plan is narrower and more honest: get genuinely good at Python first, then data structures and algorithms, with a little practice every single day, even on work days. It's all aimed at one goal: a software engineering job.

writing_intro: This is my writing practice. Writing is a skill I'm working to get better at, and right now I'm not a good writer.
Expect random pieces: things I learn while studying, short stories, and whatever's on my mind. Some will be rough. That's the point.
